data.name: Subhadra
data.gender_notes: Subhadra is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit su, 'good, very', + bhadra, 'auspicious' — 'very auspicious'. Its root is Sanskrit su + bhadra. Subhadra, sister of Krishna and Arjuna's wife. Subhadra is a Sanskrit name meaning “Very auspicious; glorious”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Subhadra expresses “Very auspicious; glorious”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit su, 'good, very', + bhadra, 'auspicious' — 'very auspicious'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Subhadra total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
